Ruling: batch #325 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-12T07:24Z

Director seat, summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB` (GitHub `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Batch #325 (two cards) was presented in chat with this seat's own readings and the recommendation "A, fallback B" for this card; the maintainer answered 「同意」, which takes the recommendation. Premises re-read on `origin/main` in this act and holding: ADR-0131 D6 (`:414`–`:419`) makes an unmanaged copy "the environment's own metadata, editable in Studio like anything authored there" and names Salesforce's unmanaged package; `:388` defines `managed` / `unmanaged` as the two states of one property, whether the package stays the authority; ADR-0010 §3.2–3.3 has the loader write a package lock into `_lock` with `_lockSource: 'package'`; `examples/` carries zero `_lock`; S2 (PR #22916) is still a draft and does not wait on this card; #15213 is open (`pm:blocked` on #22949, assignee `os-warren`).

## The ruling

**A: the unmanaged import strips every lock from each copied item, and the import result names each stripped lock together with the vendor's reason.**
- Stripped: `_lock`, `_lockReason`, `_lockSource` on every item the import copies, whether the lock was authored per item or resolved from `metadataDefaults.lock` by the loader (both arrive as the same L3 shape).
- Visible, not silent: the import result lists each stripped lock as `<type>.<name>: <_lock> — <_lockReason>` (the reason text verbatim when the author gave one), so the admin reads why the vendor had locked it before choosing to edit. That is this seat's one addition to the triage's A; it costs no gate.
- Why A and not B: a package permits `unmanaged` explicitly through `installModes`, so the vendor has already chosen to let environments take editable copies; a refusal would protect the vendor from their own declared choice. A lock whose source is the package has nothing to stand on once the package is no longer the authority (ADR-0131 `:388`). B stays the fallback if a vendor case appears that needs "copy, but never unlocked".
- Why not C: it writes an exception into D6's text and leaves `403 ITEM_LOCKED` to contradict the "editable" promise at save time.

os-decision-facets
- ① 长远合理性：非托管只有一种含义，与 Salesforce / Power Platform 的非托管一致。
- ② 实际业务拉动：今天零 `_lock` 包；S3 编写页写明「非托管 = 锁随复制去掉」。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：去锁逐条点名并带原因文本，不静默。
- ④ 不扩散：零新增门禁。
Prior rulings read: #15213 B (6108509158); ADR-0131 D6 (`:414`–`:419`), the `:380` spelling note, `:388`; ADR-0010 §3.2 (`metadataDefaults.lock` → `_lock`, `_lockSource: 'package'`), §3.3 L3; S2 report 6116157070; ACCEPT 6117037795; retriage 6118956122.

## After this ruling
- This card closes `completed` as the decision record. The strip lands in #15213's track (S3, or the S2 follow-up, whichever the `domain:spec` seat carries first); a pointer goes there.
- ⛔ No code by this seat; no dev dispatched by this seat.

Closed `completed` on ruling 6119681934 (batch #325 item 1 → **A**, the maintainer's word verbatim 「同意」): this card is the decision record. The strip, with the vendor's reason text in the import result, lands in #15213's track (S3 or the S2 follow-up). Director seat, summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`, 2026-10-12T07:25Z.
